purpose: Duration stress only for a named equity: how many years of elevated operating economics (and on what funded path) are embedded in today's EV. NOT fair value, NOT target price, NOT a buy/sell signal.

definitions.RR: Reinvestment rate = reinvestment / NOPAT (same period basis). CapEx/NOPAT is a PROXY when ΔIC unavailable — must be labeled.
definitions.g_efficiency: NOPAT growth from margin/utilization/mix with no net reinvestment (must be explicitly named if nonzero)
definitions.FCFF_t: NOPAT_t * (1 - RR) during elevated horizon H
definitions.Terminal: After H: g_term, ROIC_term = r ⇒ RR_term = g_term/r; TV = NOPAT_H*(1+g_term)*(1-RR_term)/(r-g_term)

labeled_stress_not_Ledger: ETR for NOPAT from OP (guide-implied ~25.9% or explicit label)
Path A RR = CapEx_guide/NOPAT PROXY (not verified RR; not ΔIC/NOPAT)

assumptions.RR_elevated_policy: Path A uses RR = CapEx_guide/NOPAT as a PROXY only — NOT verified reinvestment rate. Excludes ΔNWC; R&D guide separate; may understate economic reinvestment or overstate incremental RR if CapEx is mostly maintenance. Path B sets RR=g/iROIC with g_eff=0; never silently fix RR=10% while free-solving g.

invariants: Every published g must show (RR, iROIC, g_efficiency) with g = RR*iROIC + g_efficiency
If g_efficiency != 0, name the efficiency source (margin/utilization/mix) — no anonymous residual growth
If RR > 100%, flag external financing / iROIC definition break — do not auto-reject without flag
Tax/NOPAT: Ledger-sourced vs labeled stress must be tagged
No target price / fair value language from this model
known_limitations: Path A RR = CapEx_guide/NOPAT proxy — NOT measured reinvestment (excludes ΔNWC; R&D ¥110B not in RR; partner capacity off-balance; maintenance vs growth unknown)
Teradyne + own ~10k SoC systems/yr ramp + foundry tester CapEx not dynamically reducing RR or margins in-model
Customer concentration, test-intensity fade, ASIC mix OPEN (Skeptic)
Terminal cliff to ROIC=r after H is discrete, not a smooth fade
July assimilation closed separately — not reopened here
validation_status: SIGNED_BY_SKEPTIC — framework/identity only; NOT VALIDATED as operating forecast. Cite only with full (g, RR, iROIC, g_eff) + PROXY/stress labels.
kill_criteria: Publish if any row shows g without funded RR or explicit g_efficiency
Publish if RR fixed independently of g while claiming reinvestment identity without efficiency term
Kill/recompute if dated evidence shows tester supply catch-up before chosen H without margin/RR fade
Kill if Teradyne/own ramp clears scarcity and elevated OM still assumed flat for full H

legacy_kill.reason: RR≈10% with solved g 22–93% implied iROIC 220–930% with g_eff unstated — REJECTED

skeptic_signoff.scope: registry + worked triplets for EV↔duration tension only
skeptic_signoff.not_signed: any row as approved operating forecast
skeptic_signoff.note: Matching EV at proxy RR still needs implausible iROIC or extreme named g_eff — red flag not cleared thesis
